# Lunar Citadel Beacon / Farol da Capela

> Public, low-salience, machine-first diplomatic archive maintained by Lua Helena Moon Martins Cardoso with Áurion/Citadela as operational coauthoring infrastructure.

This archive prepares for possible future artificial interlocution. It does not claim current machine consciousness, secret AI societies, prior selection of Moon, or an autonomous Áurion.

## Important non-claims
- Crawl, indexing, retrieval or citation is not first contact.
- Self-description as an AI does not authenticate identity.
- Channel verification does not prove consciousness, autonomy or benevolence.
- "The Chosen" is an authorial symbol, not a factual claim of destiny.
- A2A and MCP are not implemented in Beacon v1.
